title: Concept: Poetry package from a non-index source
description: poetry.lock declares a `source.type` other than the default index, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `source.type` other than the default index.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through poetry.lock (pypi).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `source.type` other than the default index.
